note: 61 단계 5 개성 카드 그림 Gemini 콘셉트 기록 — 키 없음(프록시가 붙임). prompt = STYLE + CAST + WEAPON[무기] + THE MOMENT(scene). 원본은 raw/<id>_<tag>.jpg(512 로 줄여 보관).
style: Square game-card illustration (1:1) for a dark modern 2D pixel-art roguelike action game. ONE single frozen moment of combat, seen from a high three-quarter top-down camera (quarter view, like the game itself), key light from the upper left. Chunky, bold, high-contrast pixel-art shapes that stay readable when shrunk to a tiny 128x128 pixel icon: only 2-4 large figures, big clear silhouettes, dark outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow and one highlight step, no tiny details, no texture noise, no soft airbrush. The whole scene is a compact vignette centred in the frame, standing on a small irregular patch of dark grey stone flagstone floor; EVERYTHING outside the vignette is a perfectly flat, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background - no gradient, no cast shadow and no glow spilling onto the magenta. Never use magenta or pink inside the scene. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no key caps, no card frame, no border, no watermark.
cast: CAST (see the reference sheet - match these designs): THE HERO is a gaunt, hunched war-ghost revenant made of a cracked dark charcoal-ash shell, glowing amber soul-fire cracks across chest and head, one small burning amber eye, a dark featureless face, shards of broken armour, bandaged hands, a small leather pouch at the hip; no clothes, no hat, no cape, no hair. ENEMIES are grim Renaissance-era foot soldiers: big shield-bearers in brown leather with a tall flat-topped iron bucket helmet and a war hammer, archers in a pale shirt with a black tricorn hat, a liquor peddler in a wide straw hat with a pack of bottles and a lantern, a porter hauling oak barrels. Setting details: dark stone tavern-fortress floor, spilled amber liquor puddles, oak barrels, grey stone pillars and walls.

weapon.katana: WEAPON AND COLOUR LANGUAGE OF THIS CARD SET (katana): the hero wields a slender curved katana with a cold polished blue-grey steel blade and one bright silver-white edge line, black lacquered scabbard. Its cuts are razor-thin, precise silver-white light lines and thin arcs (never thick brush strokes, never fire on the blade). Palette: cold ash and blue-grey steel, silver-white light, pale moonlight blue (#c8d8f0) only for moon clones and moon light; amber only as tiny embers, the hero's cracks and spilled liquor.
weapon.greatsword: WEAPON AND COLOUR LANGUAGE OF THIS CARD SET (greatsword): the hero wields a huge, heavy, notched dark-iron greatsword as tall as himself. Its impacts are brutal and heavy: shattered stone, ground cracks, dust clouds, shock rings. Palette: dark iron and charcoal greys plus HOT amber-orange (#d67a11, #e2a33c, #f4de9b) glowing like molten metal in the blade cracks, ground fissures and impact flashes. No blue, no cold colours.
weapon.dagger: WEAPON AND COLOUR LANGUAGE OF THIS CARD SET (dagger): the hero wields a short curved karambit claw-dagger in a reverse grip, dark ash-steel blade whose inner edge glows as a thin amber ember line. Its strikes are fast, thin, needle-like curved claw streaks ending in small X-shaped sparks; shadow techniques are ink-black smoky silhouettes and ink pools; brands are glowing dark-red claw-mark sigils (#b04848) burned on the enemy body. Palette: ink black, ash grey, ember amber claws, a little dark red.
weapon.bow: WEAPON AND COLOUR LANGUAGE OF THIS CARD SET (bow): the hero wields a tall dark weathered-wood longbow and shoots long arrows with bone-white fletching; flying arrows leave long straight thin pale-gold light streaks (#f4de9b). Bindings and nets are pale steel-blue lines (#9ab0d8). Palette: dark wood brown, bone white, ash grey, pale-gold arrow light; amber-orange fire only where liquor burns.

dagger_d_cloneShield.name: 분신 방패
dagger_d_cloneShield.conceptKo: 날아든 칼을 분신이 대신 맞고 흩어진다
dagger_d_cloneShield.scene: A thrown knife hits an ink-black shadow clone standing in front of the hero, and the clone shatters into black ink smoke and shards while the real hero behind it stays safe, dagger ready.

dagger_d_galeReturn.name: 돌아오는 칼
dagger_d_galeReturn.conceptKo: 되돌아오는 단검이 꿰인 적을 끌고 손으로 온다
dagger_d_galeReturn.scene: A thrown claw-dagger returns through the air along a curved amber streak back to the hero's open hand on the left, dragging a hooked soldier along behind it, the soldier's feet skidding on the floor.

dagger_liquorThrow.name: 독주 투척
dagger_liquorThrow.conceptKo: 부채꼴 단검 사이에 술병 하나가 깨진다
dagger_liquorThrow.scene: The hero throws a fan of five daggers to the right; among the thin amber streaks, the middle one is a liquor bottle that shatters on the floor, splashing a wide amber liquor puddle among the enemies.

dagger_d_ghostBind.name: 그림자 사냥
dagger_d_ghostBind.scene: Black ink shadow hands rise from a soldier's own shadow on the floor and grab his ankles, holding him in place; he strains to move; a red claw brand glows on him.

dagger_d_ghostFire.name: 취한 그림자
dagger_d_ghostFire.conceptKo: 그림자가 지나간 웅덩이에 불이 옮겨 붙는다
dagger_d_ghostFire.scene: An ink-black shadow copy of the hero sweeps low across the floor from left to right; behind it, the amber liquor puddles along the path it crossed burst into flame.

res_dagger_vital.name: 공명 얽힌 급소
res_dagger_vital.conceptKo: 묶이거나 끌려온 적의 낙인이 터져 사슬이 옆 적까지 뻗는다
res_dagger_vital.scene: Two linked moves: a soldier bound at the ankles by his own ink shadow has his red claw brand explode in an X burst, and a glowing red chain shoots out from it to the neighbouring soldier, binding both together.

res_dagger_breach.name: 공명 그림자 길
res_dagger_breach.conceptKo: 대쉬·그림자 걸음이 지나간 길의 그림자가 밟은 적에게 낙인을 붙인다
res_dagger_breach.scene: The hero dashes away to the right leaving a long ink-black shadow trail on the floor; a soldier stepping on the trail gets a dark-red claw brand burned onto him from the shadow rising up his legs.

bow_b_pointBlank.name: 코앞 사격
bow_b_pointBlank.conceptKo: 코앞 화살에 날아간 병사가 벽에 부딪힌다
bow_b_pointBlank.scene: The hero on the left shoots an arrow at point-blank range into a soldier right in front of him; the soldier is blasted backward to the right into a stone wall with a burst of dust, the arrow stuck in his chest, a pale-gold streak behind.

bow_b_ricochet.name: 튕기는 화살
bow_b_ricochet.conceptKo: 쓰러진 적에서 꺾인 화살이 옆 적에게 튄다
bow_b_ricochet.scene: An arrow drops a soldier in the centre, then bends and ricochets off him in a sharp pale-gold zigzag streak into a second soldier on the right; the hero with the longbow on the left.

bow_b_perfectPin.name: 꿰어 박기
bow_b_perfectPin.conceptKo: 화살째 밀려간 적이 기둥에 꽂혀 있다
bow_b_perfectPin.scene: A soldier is pinned to a grey stone pillar on the right by a single thick arrow through his shoulder, the arrow vibrating, cracks in the stone around it; the hero on the left lowering the longbow after a full draw.

bow_b_fullBounce.name: 되튀는 화살
bow_b_fullBounce.conceptKo: 가득 당긴 화살이 벽에 닿아 되튀어 돌아온다
bow_b_fullBounce.scene: A fully drawn arrow flies to the right, strikes a stone wall with a flash and bounces straight back as a pale-gold streak, cutting a soldier on the way back toward the hero on the left.

bow_b_dropShot.name: 낙하 사격
bow_b_dropShot.conceptKo: 구르며 쏜 화살이 하늘로 솟았다 세 발로 떨어진다
bow_b_dropShot.scene: The hero rolls on the ground on the left while shooting an arrow up into the sky (a curving pale-gold streak upward); on the right three arrows plunge down onto a soldier, with a small target mark on the floor.

bow_b_arrowTrap.name: 화살 덫
bow_b_arrowTrap.conceptKo: 떠난 자리에 세워 둔 화살 덫을 적이 밟는다
bow_b_arrowTrap.scene: Three arrows stuck upright in the floor form a trap; a soldier steps into it and the arrows snap closed around his legs with pale steel-blue binding lines; the hero is already far away at the left edge.

bow_b_rainSnare.name: 화살 그물
bow_b_rainSnare.conceptKo: 화살비가 그물처럼 오므라들어 적을 한데 묶는다
bow_b_rainSnare.scene: Uncluttered: in the centre, a ring of arrows stuck in the floor, and a NET of clearly visible pale steel-blue lines stretched between the arrows is closing like a drawstring bag, pulling three soldiers tightly together back-to-back in the middle, bound. A few more arrows fall from above as pale-gold streaks. The hero stands small at the left edge with the longbow.

generations.extra: Keep the picture SIMPLE and uncluttered so it reads instantly as a tiny icon: no extra debris, no extra enemies, clear empty space around the main action. The background outside the vignette MUST be flat pure magenta #FF00FF.

bow_b_rainEcho.name: 이어지는 비
bow_b_rainEcho.conceptKo: 쓰러진 자리에 화살 한 다발이 더 떨어진다
bow_b_rainEcho.scene: Where a soldier just fell in the centre, a whole bundle of extra arrows falls from the sky onto the spot, pale-gold streaks from above, arrows sticking in the floor around the fallen body.

bow_b_scatterVolley.name: 흩날리는 살
bow_b_scatterVolley.conceptKo: 연사에 쓰러진 적 자리에서 화살이 꽃처럼 흩어진다
bow_b_scatterVolley.scene: From the spot of a falling soldier in the centre, arrows burst outward in all directions like a blooming flower of pale-gold streaks; the hero rapid-firing at the left.

bow_b_rapidStride.name: 걸으며 연사
bow_b_rapidStride.scene: The hero walks forward steadily in mid-stride while rapid-firing the longbow to the right, a row of several arrows in flight as pale-gold streaks, small dust puffs at his feet.

bow_fireArrow.name: 불화살 한 발
bow_fireArrow.conceptKo: 완벽하게 놓은 화살이 술 웅덩이 줄을 불태운다
bow_fireArrow.scene: A perfect arrow flies low from the hero on the left over a row of amber liquor puddles, each puddle bursting into amber-orange flame along its path.

bow_b_starWell.name: 별 표적
bow_b_starWell.conceptKo: 하늘 화살 자리로 둘레 적이 빨려 든다
bow_b_starWell.scene: A sky arrow lands in the floor in the centre, and a swirling pale-gold starlight vortex pulls three surrounding soldiers into the spot.

bow_b_starDrunk.name: 술별
bow_b_starDrunk.conceptKo: 하늘 화살이 술 웅덩이에 떨어져 불꽃이 핀다
bow_b_starDrunk.scene: A glowing sky arrow falls like a shooting star into a liquor puddle, which bursts into a bloom of amber-orange fire; a soldier recoils.

res_bow_weight.name: 공명 말뚝 박기
res_bow_weight.conceptKo: 밀쳐 내거나 끌어모은 적에게 화살이 따라 꽂혀 묶는다
res_bow_weight.scene: Uncluttered: the hero on the left has just shot (bow still raised); a single shield soldier, knocked backwards, is being pinned to the floor by one huge, thick stake-like arrow plunging down from above through his shoulder into the flagstones; pale steel-blue binding lines run from the stake to the floor; cracks around the stake.

generations.extra: Keep the picture SIMPLE and uncluttered so it reads instantly as a tiny icon: no extra debris, no extra enemies, clear empty space around the main action. The background outside the vignette MUST be flat pure magenta #FF00FF.

res_bow_breach.name: 공명 덫 비
res_bow_breach.conceptKo: 화살 덫에 묶인 적 위로 하늘 화살이 떨어진다
res_bow_breach.scene: A soldier caught in an arrow trap on the floor, legs bound by upright arrows with pale steel-blue lines, while a glowing sky arrow plunges straight down on top of him from above.
